description: Hexagonal re-layout to the findu-core standard (design sec.10) + domain foundation. Move presentation/, loose dto/, application/port/output and application/template into the target package tree; add domain/enums (TemplateType, AlertCategory, AudienceMode) keeping NotificationChannel for senders; extend the NotificationTemplate domain model with all common + per-type fields and introduce the Audience / AlertMeta / NotificationRouting domain objects (NOT raw maps); add domain/exception types. This FEAT must leave the micro BUILDING with the existing send flow unchanged in behavior (no new persistence/transaction logic yet - that is FEAT-002). It is the foundation every later FEAT depends on. Independent of nothing; must run FIRST.
steps: STEP 0 (build prerequisite, do ONCE): copy gradle-wrapper.jar into the worktree so .\gradlew.bat works. Copy from 'c:\Users\ADMIN\Documents\FIND-U-PROJECT\findu\CORE\findu-notification-processor\gradle\wrapper\gradle-wrapper.jar' to 'c:\Users\ADMIN\Documents\FIND-U-PROJECT\findu\.worktrees\notif-template-engine\CORE\findu-notification-processor\gradle\wrapper\gradle-wrapper.jar'. Do NOT git-add it (it is git-ignored). Confirm the baseline builds with '.\gradlew.bat build' BEFORE touching code.

Add domain/enums package: TemplateType { SMS, EMAIL, WHATSAPP, EVENTO, NOTIFICACION, ALERTA }, AlertCategory { INFO, SEGURIDAD, PREVENTIVA }, AudienceMode { TODOS, SEGMENTO, USUARIO }. MOVE domain/model/NotificationChannel.java into domain/enums (keep enum values EMAIL/SMS/PUSH/WHATSAPP - the senders still use it) and update its package + all imports.

Create domain/model value objects (Lombok @Getter/@Setter/@NoArgsConstructor/@AllArgsConstructor/@Builder): Audience { AudienceMode modo; Map<String,Object> filtros; List<String> userIds; }, NotificationRouting { String condicion; String canalSiActivo; String canalSiInactivo; }, AlertMeta { AlertCategory categoria; String pantallaDestino; String titulo; String ctaLabel; String ctaAction; boolean cerrable; Integer prioridad; String vigenciaDesde; String vigenciaHasta; String condicionAparicion; Integer tiempoDesaparicion; }.

Extend domain/model/NotificationTemplate.java per design sec.3: common fields { String id (PK CODE#TIPO#LANG), String sk, String codigo, TemplateType tipo, String language, String bodyTemplate, List<String> variables, Integer version, boolean active, Audience audiencia, String createdAt, String createdBy, String updatedAt, String updatedBy } + EMAIL { String subject, String contentType } + WHATSAPP { String waTemplateName, String contentType } + EVENTO { String rabbitExchange, String rabbitRoutingKey, String rabbitQueue, String eventType } + NOTIFICACION { String title, NotificationRouting routing } + ALERTA { AlertMeta alertMeta }. Keep legacy getters where senders/templates read subject/contentType/bodyTemplate so existing code compiles. Keep 'channel' only if still referenced after re-layout; prefer deriving channel from tipo.

Create domain/exception package: TemplateNotFoundException and InvalidTemplateException (extend RuntimeException). Update exception/GlobalExceptionHandler.java to live in infrastructure/adapter/input/web/exception (ControllerAdvice) and handle the new exceptions (404 for TemplateNotFound, 400 for InvalidTemplate); MOVE exception/ErrorResponse.java alongside it.

Re-layout ports: MOVE application/port/output/{TemplateRepositoryPort,NotificationStatusRepositoryPort}.java to application/port/out/persistence and application/port/output/NotificationSenderPort.java to application/port/out/externalapi. Update package declarations and every import across the micro.

Re-layout DTOs: MOVE dto/DeviceTokenRegistration.java to application/dto/request and dto/financial/FinancialEventEnvelopeDto.java to application/dto/request (or a financial subpackage). Update imports in DeviceController, FinancialEventConsumerController, FinancialEventRouter, handlers.
Re-layout controllers: MOVE presentation/controller/{DeviceController,FinancialEventConsumerController}.java to infrastructure/adapter/input/web/controller. Update package + imports.

Re-layout persistence adapters: ensure infrastructure/adapter/persistence/{DynamoDbTemplateAdapter,DynamoDbNotificationStatusAdapter}.java move to infrastructure/adapter/out/persistence/adapter. (Rewrite of DynamoDbTemplateAdapter logic is FEAT-002; here only relocate + fix the mapToTemplate to populate the new fields it already reads so it still compiles.) Senders stay in infrastructure/adapter/sender or move to infrastructure/adapter/out/externalapi - pick out/externalapi for consistency and update imports; keep NotificationConsumer under infrastructure/consumer.

Fix all import statements and @Component/@Service wiring broken by the moves. The Template Method subclasses (application/template/*) and NotificationTemplateFactory keep working against NotificationChannel for now.
Run '.\gradlew.bat build' and fix every compile/test error until BUILD SUCCESSFUL.
acceptance_criteria: Package tree matches design sec.10 target layout (application/{dto/{request,response},port/{in,out/{persistence,externalapi}},service/impl,util}; domain/{enums,exception,model}; infrastructure/{adapter/{input/web/controller,out/persistence/adapter},config,consumer}).
domain/enums contains TemplateType (6 values), AlertCategory (3), AudienceMode (3), and the relocated NotificationChannel.
NotificationTemplate carries all common + per-type fields from design sec.3 and uses Audience/AlertMeta/NotificationRouting domain objects, not raw Maps (Audience.filtros may stay a Map).
No source file remains under presentation/, dto/ (root), application/port/output/, or exception/ (root) - all relocated.
'.\gradlew.bat build' from the micro dir prints BUILD SUCCESSFUL and the existing FinancialEventRouterTest still passes.

findings: BUILD SUCCESSFUL (FinancialEventRouterTest passes). Final package locations (base com.findu.notification.processor): ENUMS -> domain.enums.{TemplateType(SMS,EMAIL,WHATSAPP,EVENTO,NOTIFICACION,ALERTA), AlertCategory(INFO,SEGURIDAD,PREVENTIVA), AudienceMode(TODOS,SEGMENTO,USUARIO), NotificationChannel(EMAIL,SMS,PUSH,WHATSAPP)}. NotificationChannel MOVED out of domain.model into domain.enums; senders/templates/NotificationResult/NotificationTemplateFactory import it from domain.enums. DOMAIN MODEL VOs -> domain.model.{Audience(AudienceMode modo, Map<String,Object> filtros, List<String> userIds), NotificationRouting(String condicion, canalSiActivo, canalSiInactivo), AlertMeta(AlertCategory categoria, String pantallaDestino, titulo, ctaLabel, ctaAction, boolean cerrable, Integer prioridad, String vigenciaDesde, vigenciaHasta, condicionAparicion, Integer tiempoDesaparicion)}. NotificationTemplate field names (domain.model.NotificationTemplate, Lombok @Builder/@Getter/@Setter): common {String id, String sk, String codigo, TemplateType tipo, String language, String bodyTemplate, List<String> variables, Integer version, boolean active, Audience audiencia, String createdAt, createdBy, updatedAt, updatedBy}; LEGACY retained for compile {String channel, String subject, String contentType}; EMAIL {subject, contentType}; WHATSAPP {String waTemplateName, contentType}; EVENTO {String rabbitExchange, rabbitRoutingKey, rabbitQueue, eventType}; NOTIFICACION {String title, NotificationRouting routing}; ALERTA {AlertMeta alertMeta}. NOTE: ALERTA uses nested AlertMeta object (not flat alert fields on the template). EXCEPTIONS -> domain.exception.{TemplateNotFoundException, InvalidTemplateException} (extend RuntimeException). WEB exception advice -> infrastructure.adapter.input.web.exception.{GlobalExceptionHandler(@RestControllerAdvice: 404 TemplateNotFound, 400 InvalidTemplate+IllegalArgument, 500 generic), ErrorResponse(record int status,String message)}. PORTS -> application.port.out.persistence.{TemplateRepositoryPort, NotificationStatusRepositoryPort} and application.port.out.externalapi.NotificationSenderPort. DTOs -> application.dto.request.{DeviceTokenRegistration, FinancialEventEnvelopeDto}. CONTROLLERS -> infrastructure.adapter.input.web.controller.{DeviceController, FinancialEventConsumerController}. SENDERS -> infrastructure.adapter.out.externalapi.{SnsSmsender, SesEmailSender, FirebasePushSender, WhatsappSender}. PERSISTENCE ADAPTERS -> infrastructure.adapter.out.persistence.adapter.{DynamoDbTemplateAdapter, DynamoDbNotificationStatusAdapter}. NotificationConsumer stays infrastructure.consumer. DynamoDbTemplateAdapter still RELOCATE-ONLY (FEAT-002 rewrites to v#ACTIVE/transactions): maps DynamoDB attrs id, channel, language, content_type, subject, body_template, version, is_active -> template fields id/channel/language/contentType/subject/bodyTemplate/version/active. Existing attr names (snake_case): content_type, body_template, is_active; status table findu_notifications uses notification_id, status, processed_at, event_json, error_code, error_description, retries. New DynamoDB attrs for the dynamic model (sk, codigo, tipo, variables, audiencia, created_at/by, updated_at/by, per-type fields) are NOT yet mapped by the adapter -- FEAT-002 to define exact item attribute names. gradle-wrapper.jar copied into worktree (git-ignored, NOT committed).
